_comment: Bubblewrap/TWA config for the PoeTech PWA. Prefilled from app/public/manifest.webmanifest. Used by `bubblewrap init --manifest` or as a reference for PWABuilder. Pick a final packageId before publishing (cannot change after first Play upload).
name: PoeTech Family OS
_signingNote: bubblewrap build will generate a signing keystore and print the SHA-256 fingerprint you must place in assetlinks.json. Keep that keystore safe and backed up -- losing it means you can never update the Play listing.
